source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 28. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: The fourth pillar: from dawn to sunset in Ramadan

learn.en: Sawm means not eating or drinking from dawn to sunset. Fasting in Ramadan is the fourth pillar of Islam.
learn.title: What is sawm?

learn.en: Ramadan is the ninth month of the Islamic calendar. The fast starts the day after the new moon of Ramadan is seen.
learn.title: The new moon

learn.en: As soon as the sun sets, we break the fast. This is called iftar.
learn.title: Iftar

learn.en: “O you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you, that you may become righteous.” (Qur'an 2:183)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

quiz.en: Sawm is the ___ pillar of Islam.
While fasting, we don't eat or drink during…
Ramadan is the ___ month of the Islamic calendar.
True or false? The fast begins the day after the new moon of Ramadan is seen.

think.q: Could you try fasting for half a day this Ramadan? What would help you?
think.a: A good suhur, keeping busy, and lots of du'aa!

parents.summary: Sawm: no food or drink from dawn to sunset in Ramadan (the 9th month); it starts after the new moon; we break it at iftar.
parents.tip: Let him help prepare the family iftar.
